faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar is 09 October 2026. Candidates must submit their applications via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post in the NIT Silchar Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Silchar Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Assistant posts at NIT Silchar is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application and documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Assistant posts at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Assistant posts at NIT Silchar is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Assistant at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar will receive a salary of Rs. 15000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Assistant post must have a 3 years Diploma in Electronics Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institute or university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NIT Silchar Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026. The fee is Nil for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Silchar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Silchar is located in Silchar, Assam. The pincode for the institute is 788010.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The official website for National Institute of Technology Silchar is www.nits.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more details and updates regarding the recruitment.
